subject: Perk registry
notes: Level costs, gates and every line of effect text are transcribed from the in-game skill screens; the wording is verbatim.
Tree positions, prerequisite links and upgrade-level counts were read from in-game skill screens.
Node names were resolved by matching each in-game icon against the named perk icon set, then verified by eye.
`active_time` is recorded per perk: ANYTIME, DAY ONLY or NIGHT ONLY, exactly as the banner above the perk name reads. It is not uniform within a tree - Witchcraft mixes ANYTIME and DAY ONLY.

Gates are per level, read from the icon on each level row: a book means that level needs a manual, a plain diamond means skill points only. `road shrine` is a gate the published sources do not list at all.

A level row whose cost is hidden in game is one the capture's save had already bought; those costs are kept from the Game8 cross-check rather than guessed. Ownership itself is never recorded - it is save state, not perk data.
Some levels cost skill points but no time segments, so `time_segments` can be 0. The published tables list a time segment everywhere.
Some sources list two rows both labelled 'Lv. 3'. The second is Lv. 4; in-game pips confirm four slots on those perks.
Font of Life and Mandrake Ward are padlocked '?' nodes with no skill point or time cost - story or quest unlocks.
Vampirism ultimates are gated by Corruption 15 alone; only Witchcraft and Swordmastery show the 35-point spend counter.
Where the registry knowingly departs from the Game8 page, source_overrides records the field and the reason.

`text_source` records where each level row's text came from: `game` (read from the in-game panel), `game8` (still the Game8 table, never re-read from the game), or `placeholder` (a padlocked story node that prints no effect line).
